question.problem: If $\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta =0.25$ and $\theta $ is acute, then the value of $\theta $ in degrees to one decimal place is
question.worked_solution:
To find $\theta $ we use $arctan.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta  & =0.25 \\ \operatorname{arctan}⁡(\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta ) & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(0.25) \\ \theta  & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(0.25).\end{aligned}
$$

Using a calculator, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}\theta  & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(0.25). \\  & =(14.036\,2…)^{∘} \\  & ≈{14.0}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to one decimal place.
